column5: Creates a tiny geyser. It reaches quite high and is fast\, so it can catch opponents off guard.
An extremely powerful kick. This move harms the user as well\, however for a very brief moment Mokou assumes guarding stance to avoid taking major damage.
Launches away exploding bamboo tubes. It's a move that can be done to dodge attacks as well.
Calls upon a horde of fire bird. It's not really a coordinated attack\, so the power is low.
Scatters a few fire birds over an area. The birds are harmless\, but it keeps leaving fiery trail.
Creates a fiery wave by slashing consecutively. It's an attack with multiple parts that can be progressed by pressing the button again\, however each use harms the user so caution is required.
Turns into an egg. She is invincible during it\, and will hop out of it after healing for a certain amount of time. Usable in air only.
Summons a fire bird. The bird can be somewhat controlled with movements\, however it disappears when moving between ground and air
Shoots phoenix feathers forward. It's not really aimed\, but it covers a big area.
Leaps forward and punches the opponent. It's a fast and powerful attack\, although the impact is a bit harmful to oneself.
Leaps and stomps the opponent's head. The arc can be controlled slightly\, and she has her own arsenal of move if the stomp landed.
Sends a surge of volcanic fires to the ground\, which she can trigger anytime later.
Calls forth an asteroid. It takes time for it to reach the ground\, but it's a powerful attack that should be evaded. Of course\, it's not really an asteroid.
Spins rapidly while emitting a fiery whirlwind. She's burning herself\, however she's taking her opponent with her.
Calls upon a volcanic storm. Strong wind pushes the opponent to the corner for a short duration.
A card that can only be used in the air. She turns into an egg to resurrect herself\, however she also does this by creating a fire tornado on her wake.
Hurls a powerful flaming fist on the opponent\, which then leaves a fire projectile attack.
The spirit of a Phoenix possesses the target\, which attacks the possessed target repeatedly over time.
Grows a pair of wings for a short period of time. This allows her to move very fast\, while granting protection to projectiles.
Executes a diving punch which causes a volcanic eruption upon impact with the ground. It is said to be as beautiful and deadly as natural volcanic eruption.
Summons a Phoenix projectile which she can control indirectly with her own movements. It's a Phoenix\, so it's indestructible.
An extremely powerful kick. However due to how powerful this move is\, it's a double-edged sword that does massive damage to the user as well.
